name: web-split-3d-object-analytics-dashboard
title: Split Dashboard with 3D Satellite Dish
whatItIs: A framed dashboard split into a black left panel showing a glassy 3D satellite dish with faint grid, and a light right panel with KPI tiles, severity-tagged threat cards, a line chart and segmented bar meters for CPU, memory and network.
whatItMeans: The dark hero object gives the dashboard a memorable identity and thematic metaphor (listening, monitoring), while the light data side stays readable and orderly.
techniques: Half-dark, half-light split to separate mood from information
3D object as a thematic illustration inside a data product
Small colored severity tags for triage
Segmented bar meters colored by health level
bestFor: Products that need a memorable visual metaphor

vocabulary.definition: A layout divided into two contrasting halves.
A bar composed of small discrete blocks that fill to show a value.
A small colored label showing priority level.
